name: Visual Saccadic Latency Law
axiom: Vision pauses during rapid eye jumps; a clear field is read only during fixations.
trigger: A form's labels sit far from their fields, so the eye must travel for every answer.
checklist: Align form labels directly above or beside their fields, on one vertical axis.
Keep badges and status text inline with the row they describe.
Do not split one reading task across the far edges of a wide screen.

antiPattern.violation: A form alternates inputs between two columns, forcing zig-zag eye travel and skipped fields.
antiPattern.remediation: One vertical column, label above each field, reads top to bottom.

parametricParams.caption: CLEAR READING HAPPENS AT FIXATIONS, NOT BETWEEN
